notes.title: 0.3.2 [The Gamemode Update]
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Added Gamemodes
- Added Custom Gamemodes
- Added timer
- Added lives
- Added teams
- Cleaned up how modded maps are displayed
- Fixed player movement

notes.title: 0.2.9 MOD UPDATE
notes.notes:
Changelog
- Added mod loading in menu
- Added automatic mod downloading via socket.io
- Added ps_cheats command
- Added toggle-godmode command
- Added toggle-noclip command
- Fixed weapon animations when shooting when reloading
- Improved level loading
- Improved player spawning and syncing

notes.title: 0.1.5 Network Update and Fixes
notes.notes:
Changelog
-Updated player movement to sync at 30 messages per second
-Fixed players sliding on slopes
-Fixed memory leaks when receiving messages
-Fixed messages not being removed after processed
-Made processed messages be removed after 1 second to use less resources

notes.title: 0.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
0.1.1 Changelogs:
- Added Dashing
- Added game information on launch
- Added new weapon walk animation
- Added transition effect for launching main menu
- Changed player to have "first person" and "third person" model states
- Fixed player animator issues
- Fixed player camera/weapon model shaking
